The Director will lead multiple engineering teams and managers across platform workstreams including Cache & Queues and help build the shared control-plane, data-plane, and management-plane capabilities that make storage consumable as an internal service. The Cache & Queues engineering organization will report to this role. STaaS is moving Docusign from infrastructure-oriented consumption to a service-based model. Product teams should be able to provision, use, and operate logical storage resources through standardized interfaces without managing the underlying Azure or Google Cloud implementation details. This leader will turn that strategy into a durable internal platform product, a high-performing India organization, and a globally aligned operating model. The STaaS organization builds internal storage products and abstractions across three planes: Control plane (logical resource definitions, provisioning, lifecycle management, policy, and infrastructure automation), Data plane (protocols, client libraries, sidecars, gateways, routing, and high-performance access paths), and Management plane (telemetry, dashboards, alerts, operational tooling, recommendations, and safe production workflows). * 8+ years of experience leading engineering organizations, including multiple managers and senior individual contributors
* Experience managing managers and leading multi-team portfolios across backend, infrastructure, platform, storage, database, messaging, caching, or reliability engineering

* Experience with distributed systems, availability, performance, capacity planning, security, observability, and disaster recovery

**Preferred**

* Experience leading multi-cloud platform strategy across Azure and Google Cloud

description:
The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers.

Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.

That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.

Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry-changing realities.

For our business, for clients, and for you

**Jr AppSec Engineer**

**Application security assurance, governance and risk decisions**

**Job Posting Title**

**Jr AppSec Engineer**

**Department**

Information Security - Application Security

  

**Employment Type**

Permanent

  

**Management Level**

Assistant Vice President 3

  

**About Apex**

Apex Group Ltd., established in Bermuda in 2003, is a global financial services provider. With 50 offices worldwide and 12,000 employees upon the close of announced acquisitions, Apex delivers an extensive range of services to asset managers, capital markets, private clients and family offices.

The Group has continually improved and evolved its capabilities to offer a single-source solution through establishing the broadest range of services in the industry, including fund services, digital onboarding and bank accounts, depositary, custody and super ManCo services, business services including HR and Payroll, and a pioneering ESG Ratings and Advisory service for private companies.

We look to recruit bright, articulate and numerate employees who are not afraid of a challenge. We value people who work hard, care about what they do and are prepared to innovate.

Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today. As we grow, that contribution becomes even more important. Whatever your career path or specialism, Apex provides a global platform to help you thrive.

  

**About the Role**

This AVP3 position is a senior individual-contributor role focused on consistent, risk-based application security assurance across a large application estate. It covers application discovery and classification, proportionate security reviews, evidence quality, exceptions and a clear view of coverage and residual risk.

Although the posting title is Jr AppSec Engineer, the management level requires mature judgement, credible stakeholder leadership and the ability to quality-review assurance decisions. The role remains technically grounded and must recognise when manual testing or specialist review is required.

  

**Location:** Hyderabad, India. This is an office-based position and is not available as a remote role.

  

**Key Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead application and API discovery campaigns with technology, business and governance stakeholders; reconcile inventories, identify ownership gaps and define the population requiring AppSec oversight.

* Apply and improve risk-classification criteria using criticality, data, exposure, users, transactions, technology, regulatory relevance, threat and change to determine assurance depth and cadence.

* Review existing security evidence for control intent, scope, recency, testing method and applicability; reuse credible evidence and identify requirements that still need review or testing.

* Create proportionate assurance plans that combine existing evidence, questionnaires, design review, threat modelling, automated control results and specialist testing based on risk.

* Direct proportionate application security reviews, track completion and quality-review decisions with explicit conditions, assumptions and validity periods.

* Coordinate with AppSec testing, Red Team and DevSecOps colleagues when technical depth is required; ensure their output is incorporated into the assurance decision.

* Collaborate with architecture teams on security requirements and risk challenge without taking ownership of target architecture, solution design or design-authority decisions.

* Support threat-modelling and secure-design discussions, ensuring actions have owners and are reflected in delivery plans and acceptance criteria.

* Govern exceptions and risk acceptance: confirm accountable ownership, rationale, risk statement, compensating controls, remediation plan, expiry and required approval.

* Challenge weak or incomplete evidence and prevent administrative completion from being treated as security effectiveness.

* Maintain clear review records, decision logs and evidence traceability for governance, audit and regulatory review.

* Define metrics for population coverage, risk tiers, assessment status, evidence reuse, gaps, findings, remediation, exceptions and overdue decisions; explain trends and limitations.

* Prepare concise governance reporting and facilitate decisions with application owners, engineering leaders, Information Security, Risk, Compliance and Audit.

Coach junior assurance staff, calibrate decisions across reviewers and improve standards, templates and playbooks using lessons from delivery.  

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**

* Typically 6+ years in application security assurance, technology risk, product security, security governance or a closely related discipline.

* Demonstrated experience delivering risk-based application security assurance across multiple applications and stakeholder groups.

* Strong judgement in evidence sufficiency, control effectiveness, risk classification, exception quality and review conditions.

* Working knowledge of application architectures, web and API risk, threat modelling, secure development and automated security testing.

* Ability to translate between technical findings, control requirements, business impact and accountable risk decisions.

* Experience producing governance metrics and evidence that can withstand audit or regulatory challenge.

* Confident stakeholder facilitation and escalation, including the ability to challenge senior owners constructively.

* Strong written documentation, attention to traceability and ability to manage a sizeable portfolio.

Fluent English, spoken and written.  

  

**Additional Practical Experience**

* Experience in financial services or another regulated global organisation.

* Familiarity with control frameworks and secure development standards such as NIST SSDF, OWASP SAMM, ASVS, ISO 27001 or similar.

* Experience with GRC platforms, application inventories, work-management tools or evidence automation.

* Evidence of practical capability improving application security assurance or secure development practices.

Experience improving an assurance operating model or rationalising duplicate controls.  

  

**Candidate Expectations**

* Be rigorous about evidence while making assurance proportionate to actual risk.

* Do not confuse process completion with an effective security outcome.

* State assumptions, gaps, conditions and decision ownership clearly; avoid ambiguous conclusions.

* Use metrics to support decisions and improvement, not to create false precision.

* Build trusted relationships and lead governance activity from the Hyderabad office.

Apex operates a direct sourcing model and where agency assistance is required, the Talent Acquisition team will engage directly with our exclusive recruitment partners.

About the Role
  
NTT DATA is looking for someone to own the digital assets our global AI Go-to-Market organization runs on: the AI demo catalog ("Periodic Table"), software demonstrations, sales and solution presentations, client-ready materials, and enablement content.

AI-assisted operations. description:
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

**Category** Engineering **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 19776 **Date posted** 11/16/2026

### **We Are**

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**

You have built software that sits between hardware and the people who need to verify it works. The kind of code that does not get applause but absolutely gets noticed when it breaks. You understand that a clean API matters more than clever code, and that the best abstraction is the one that makes the next engineer's job easier, not the one that shows off what you know.

You are comfortable in C++ when performance matters and Python when speed of iteration matters, and you know which context calls for which. Hardware interfaces do not intimidate you. You have worked with protocols like AXI or similar interconnects, maybe not as a hardware designer but enough to model them, debug them, and make them behave in a software stack.

Debugging across boundaries is where you thrive. When an issue spans a hardware model, an IP component, and a platform integration layer, you do not wait for someone else to triangulate it. You dig in, reproduce it, and fix it in a way that does not create three new problems downstream.

At Synopsys, you will work on the software and workflows that power emulation, prototyping, and hardware-assisted verification platforms used to build some of the most complex chips in the world.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Design and develop C/C++ system software and platform components that support emulation, IP integration, and EDA workflows used across Synopsys hardware-assisted verification platforms
* Build subsystem-level frameworks that enable integration, validation, and reuse of IP and EDA components across multi-team engineering environments
* Develop system-level models, interfaces, and APIs that enable hardware/software co-development, platform validation, and early software bring-up
* Write Python-based automation and tooling to orchestrate workflows, accelerate platform development, and improve engineering productivity
* Work with hardware interfaces and protocols such as AXI, including software models and transaction-level abstractions that bridge hardware IP and system software
* Test, debug, profile, and optimize complex software components across large C/C++ and Linux-based codebases using tools like GDB and Valgrind
* Collaborate with IP, EDA, verification, emulation, prototyping, and firmware teams to translate system requirements into scalable, maintainable software solutions

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Your platform software will enable engineering teams to integrate, validate, and deploy IP and EDA components faster and with fewer integration failures
* The frameworks you build will be reused across multiple product lines, reducing duplicate work and accelerating time to deployment for new platform features
* Your automation and tooling will directly improve developer productivity, cutting down manual workflow steps and reducing time spent debugging environment issues
* The APIs and abstractions you design will make it easier for downstream teams to build on top of your work without needing to understand every layer beneath it
* Your debugging work will unblock critical issues that span hardware models, software stacks, and EDA tools, keeping platform development on schedule
* The system-level models you develop will enable earlier software bring-up and more accurate co-verification, reducing costly late-stage integration surprises
* Your contributions to build infrastructure, regression frameworks, and CI/CD pipelines will improve code quality and deployment reliability across the team

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* Strong hands-on programming skills in C and C++, including object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, memory management, debugging, and multithreaded or concurrent software concepts
* Working proficiency in Python for automation, scripting, tooling, or workflow development
* Solid understanding of Linux-based software development environments and debugging practices
* Ability to debug issues across multi-component software systems and diagnose problems that span hardware models, IP, platform software, and verification environments
* Experience with SystemC and Transaction-Level Modeling (TLM 2.0) is a plus
* Familiarity with AMBA/AXI protocols or similar SoC interconnect technologies is a plus

### **Who You Are**

* You can move between hardware concepts, system-level models, C/C++ software, Python automation, and EDA workflows without losing the thread of what you are actually building
* You do not wait for perfect documentation or fully defined requirements, you ask the right questions, align with stakeholders, and find a way through ambiguity
* When you build an API or framework, you think about the engineer who will use it six months from now, not just the one who needs it today
* You can explain a complex tradeoff between performance, maintainability, and time to delivery in a way that helps the team make the right call
* You treat debugging as a skill, not a chore, and you know how to isolate a problem across subsystem boundaries without creating noise for other teams
* You care about code quality, modularity, and maintainability because you have seen what happens when those things are ignored in a large codebase

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**

You will be part of the Synopsys Hardware Assisted Verification (HAV) team, a worldwide leader in hardware and software co-verification solutions. The team delivers transaction-based co-emulation, in-circuit emulation, and prototyping platforms that enable customers to accelerate hardware verification, software bring-up, system validation, and system-level development for advanced semiconductor designs. You will collaborate with IP, EDA, verification, emulation, prototyping, firmware, and platform engineering teams across Synopsys.

### **Rewards and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

  
  

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

**About this opportunity**

Align Technology is a global medical device company with industry-leading innovative products such as Invisalign clear aligners, iTero Intraoral scanners, and OrthoCAD digital services that help dental professionals achieve the clinical results they expect and deliver effective, cutting-edge dental options to their patients.

Align Technology has always set the bar for leadership and change in our industry by constantly innovating to bring new and better solutions to doctors and their patients. In 1999, Align Technology pioneered the invisible orthodontics market with the introduction of the Invisalign system and by 2001 had manufactured one million unique clear aligners. By combining digital treatment planning and mass-customization, with shape-engineering based on biomechanical principles, we have revolutionized the orthodontic industry. Today, we've helped treat over 5 million patients with the Invisalign system and are driving the evolution in digital dentistry with the iTero Intraoral scanner helping to modernize today’s practices by replacing physical impressions, taking treatment planning online, and creating the potential to enable and improve almost every type of dental treatment offered.

title: Manager, SRE Governance & Resilience
description:
**Role Purpose**
================

The Manager, SRE Governance & Resilience is responsible for establishing and leading a consistent governance, operational resilience and continuous improvement framework across Risk Intelligence Site Reliability Engineering.

The role provides leadership in strengthening operational controls, service continuity, resilience assurance, process maturity and execution discipline across business-critical Risk Intelligence platforms.

Operating across Product SRE, Project SRE and Production Operations (ProdOps), the position ensures that operational risks are understood, governance obligations are consistently implemented, and resilience capabilities are regularly assessed against business and regulatory requirements.

The role combines strong technology operations knowledge, operational risk and governance expertise, and programme delivery capabilities, with the ability to influence senior engineering stakeholders and drive measurable improvements across the global SRE organisation.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**1. SRE Governance & Operational Controls**

* Lead the development and continuous improvement of the RI SRE operational governance framework.
* Establish consistent controls, standards and assurance practices across Incident, Problem, Change, Capacity, IT Service Continuity, Backup and Data Retention, Hardware and Software Asset Management, Technology Lifecycle, Cloud Security and Disaster Recovery.
* Maintain clear control ownership, governance calendars, operating procedures, evidence requirements and exception management processes.
* Assess operational control effectiveness, identify material weaknesses and drive remediation with accountable engineering and service owners.
* Represent RI SRE in technology governance, operational risk, audit and control forums.
Ensure alignment with enterprise policies and applicable regulatory requirements without duplicating independent assurance responsibilities.  

**2. Operational Resilience, DR, BMR & Recovery Assurance**

* Lead the operational resilience governance and assurance agenda across the RI technology portfolio.
* Establish a consolidated view of critical services, recovery obligations, resilience dependencies and outstanding risks.
* Oversee the planning, coordination and assurance of disaster recovery, bare metal recovery, backup validation and service continuity exercises.
* Ensure recovery capabilities are regularly assessed against agreed Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs).
* Drive remediation of gaps identified through resilience exercises, recovery testing and operational assessments.
* Strengthen governance around immutable backups, cyber recovery readiness and recovery evidence.
Work closely with Product SRE, Cloud Platform and specialist engineering teams to improve resilience maturity and demonstrable recoverability.  

**3. Capacity Management & Service Performance Governance**

* Establish consistent capacity management governance across production services.
* Oversee regular capacity and performance reviews, ensuring critical services maintain appropriate forecasts, monitoring and risk assessments.
* Challenge unresolved capacity constraints, performance risks and scalability weaknesses.
* Coordinate capacity improvement priorities with Product SRE, Cloud Platform, Architecture and FinOps stakeholders.
Ensure capacity-related risks and investment requirements are visible within operational and strategic planning.  

**4. Incident, Problem & Change Management Maturity**

* Lead the continuous improvement of Incident, Problem and Change Management practices within RI SRE.
* Establish maturity assessments and measurable improvement plans aligned with enterprise standards.
* Drive stronger governance of major incident follow-up actions, recurring problems, known errors and corrective and preventive actions.
* Promote risk-based change enablement, deployment automation, rollback readiness and post-change validation.
* Challenge recurring process weaknesses and coordinate improvements across ProdOps, Product SRE and Project SRE.
Measure effectiveness through operational outcomes such as repeat incident reduction, change reliability and restoration performance.  

**5. Production Readiness & Service Transition Governance**

* Oversee governance requirements for Production Readiness Reviews, operational acceptance and service transitions.
* Ensure appropriate evidence exists for observability, capacity, resilience, security, operational support and recovery readiness.
* Maintain visibility of material readiness gaps, exceptions and outstanding remediation commitments.
* Partner with Project SRE and Product SRE leaders to strengthen production readiness standards and service onboarding practices.
Drive improvements based on post-go-live reviews and operational feedback.  

**6. Strategic Delivery & Cross-Functional Execution**

* Lead coordination of SRE transformation initiatives, governance improvements and operational resilience programmes.
* Establish clear delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, risks and escalation mechanisms.
* Facilitate cross-functional reviews and ensure improvement initiatives progress against agreed commitments.
* Resolve delivery blockers through effective stakeholder engagement and escalation.
Support SRE leadership in translating strategic priorities into measurable execution outcomes.  

**7. Operational Intelligence & Executive Reporting**

* Lead the development of consistent operational governance, resilience and performance reporting across RI SRE.
* Consolidate management information covering incident trends, change maturity, resilience compliance, capacity risk, backup assurance, technology currency and control effectiveness.
* Drive improvements in reporting automation, data quality and service ownership mapping.
* Partner with reporting and data specialists to leverage ServiceNow, LeanIX, Datadog, BigPanda, Wiz and enterprise analytics platforms.
Provide concise, risk-focused reporting and recommendations to SRE and technology leadership.  

**8. Continuous Improvement & Operating Model Maturity**

* Drive improvements in the RI SRE Target Operating Model, ensuring governance and resilience practices are consistent across all SRE pillars.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise and automate operational controls and assurance processes.
* Promote clear accountability, effective collaboration and reduced duplication across SRE, Engineering and enterprise control functions.
* Establish measurable maturity improvement plans and monitor progress.
* Support the adoption of modern, engineering-led operational practices while maintaining appropriate governance and control discipline.

**Skills & Experience**
=======================

**Essential**

* Significant experience in technology operations, Site Reliability Engineering, infrastructure operations, IT service management, technology governance or operational resilience.
* Demonstrated experience leading operational governance, resilience or service improvement initiatives across complex enterprise technology environments.
* Strong understanding of cloud-based production systems, distributed applications and modern engineering operating models.
* Practical knowledge of Incident, Problem, Change, Capacity and IT Service Continuity Management.
* Experience coordinating disaster recovery, backup assurance, recovery testing and operational resilience assessments.
* Strong programme and delivery management capabilities, including risk management, dependency tracking and cross-functional execution.
* Ability to interpret technical evidence, challenge operational risks and influence senior Engineering and Technology stakeholders.
* Experience establishing operational governance frameworks, control tracking and executive reporting.
* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management and leadership skills.
* Ability to drive outcomes across globally distributed teams without relying solely on formal reporting authority.
  

**Desirable**

* Experience within SRE, Platform Engineering, Production Engineering or Cloud Operations.
* Experience in financial services or other highly regulated technology environments.
* Familiarity with AWS, Azure, Kubernetes and cloud-native application architectures.
* Understanding of SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, observability and modern reliability engineering practices.
* Experience with bare metal recovery, cyber recovery, immutable backup assurance and capacity engineering.
* Knowledge of FinOps, technology obsolescence, vulnerability remediation and cloud security controls.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow, LeanIX, Datadog, BigPanda, Wiz, Power BI and enterprise reporting platforms.

**Leadership & Behavioural Expectations**
=========================================

* **Accountability:** Takes ownership of governance effectiveness, resilience assurance and execution outcomes.
* **Technical Credibility:** Demonstrates sufficient technical understanding to challenge engineering evidence and identify material operational weaknesses.
* **Strategic Thinking:** Anticipates operational risks and drives sustainable improvements rather than reactive compliance activities.
* **Partnership:** Builds trusted relationships across SRE, Engineering, Service Management, Cloud Platform, Cyber Security and Risk.
* **Execution Discipline:** Drives priorities, decisions and remediation commitments through to completion.
* **Integrity:** Promotes transparent reporting, evidence-based assessment and responsible escalation.

**Build Your Future With Us**

The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.

We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.

AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.

Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.

**THE ROLE**

At Sovos, we're building an AI-native engineering culture where humans and intelligent agents collaborate on production systems at scale. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll own outcomes across the entire stack, from React interfaces to Python services on AWS, shaping architecture, setting standards, and helping define what spec-driven, agent-assisted engineering looks like in practice.

*More specifically, you will:*

* Design, build, and maintain React (TypeScript) user interfaces and Python services and APIs that are performant, secure, accessible, and scalable.
* Own features end to end: from UI and API contract through data model, deployment, and monitoring.
* Lead architectural design and guide technical direction across front end, back end, and cloud infrastructure.
* Practise spec-driven development: write precise specifications, contracts, and acceptance criteria that humans and agents can implement and verify against.
* Work daily with coding agents (Claude Code or similar): break work into well-scoped tasks, direct agents across the stack, and critically review everything they produce for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.
* Build the guardrails that make the team more effective, such as shared agent configuration, reusable skills and commands, and MCP integrations.
* Deliver on AWS (ECS, EKS, Lambda, Bedrock) with SQL and NoSQL databases, using RESTful and event-driven APIs.
* Make test automation the safety net for agent-assisted speed: unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end tests running in CI/CD on every change.
* Build AI-powered features where they add value, with proper evaluation, observability, and cost awareness.
* Mentor teammates on AI-assisted practices, specification writing, and code review.

**WHAT YOU BRING TO SOVOS**

* You've built solid professional full stack experience with Python and React (TypeScript, modern hooks-based patterns) in production.
* You have strong experience with AWS services such as ECS, EKS, Lambda, and Bedrock.
* You bring strong SQL and NoSQL design and optimisation skills.
* You have hands-on experience with microservices, Docker, and Kubernetes.
* You've practised hands-on test automation across the stack (e.g., Pytest, Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright, Cypress).
* You've built and maintained CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or similar.
* You have hands-on experience with coding agents (Claude Code, Copilot agent mode, Cursor, or similar) on real production work, plus a spec-first mindset.
* You bring strong code-review judgement, including spotting plausible-but-wrong or insecure AI-generated code.
* You have excellent communication skills and a collaborative, ownership-driven mindset.
* Bonus: Experience building LLM-powered features or agents (Bedrock, tool use, MCP, RAG, evals), working with design systems or component libraries, or managing observability and cost for cloud and AI workloads.
* Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.

Prepare and publish job descriptions, screen resumes and shortlist suitable candidates.

Schedule interviews, coordinate with candidates and facilitate the selection process.

Negotiate salary expectations and coordinate offer rollouts.

Maintain recruitment trackers and ensure timely closure of vacancies.

**B. Employee Onboarding & Exit Management**

Manage joining formalities, documentation and employee induction.

Prepare appointment letters, employment contracts, confirmation letters and other HR-related documents.

Maintain employee personal files and update employee databases.

Handle employee separation formalities, resignation documentation, exit interviews and full & final coordination.

Ensure timely completion of handover and clearance formalities.

**C. Attendance, Leave & Payroll Management**

Monitor daily attendance, biometric records, leave applications and employee timesheets.

Maintain and update attendance and leave records.

Coordinate monthly payroll processing with the Accounts/Finance Department.

Verify attendance, leaves, salary inputs, incentives, deductions and other payroll components.

Ensure timely submission of monthly payroll inputs.

Maintain records of salary revisions, increments, bonuses and other employee benefits.

Coordinate statutory compliance requirements applicable to the organisation, including PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, TDS and other applicable labour law requirements.

Maintain employee-related statutory records and registers.

Coordinate with external consultants and government authorities wherever required.

Ensure proper documentation and timely submission of statutory information.

Maintain employee communication records and HR announcements.

Coordinate employee welfare initiatives and workplace administration.

Support the management in maintaining a professional and employee-friendly work culture.

Prepare and maintain monthly HR MIS reports.

Maintain updated employee master data, manpower reports and organisation charts.

Maintain HR trackers, employee documentation and confidential records.

Submit periodic HR reports to the HR Head and management.

MBA / PGDM in Human Resource Management preferred.

Graduate in any discipline.

Strong knowledge of recruitment, payroll coordination, attendance and leave management.

Understanding of applicable labour laws and statutory compliance.

Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint and HRMS/attendance management systems.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Strong coordination, interpersonal and problem-solving abilities.

Ability to handle multiple HR responsibilities independently.

High level of integrity and ability to maintain confidentiality.

Ownership and accountability.

Effective communication and interpersonal skills.

Problem-solving and decision-making.

Professionalism and employee-centric approach.
